If you are having trouble with Data Cleaning Workshop we suggest the following steps:

1. Read through our [FAQ (frequently Asked Questions)](https://github.com/datarootsio/data-cleaning-workshop) 
2. Search for similar issues in our community email list archives: https://github.com/datarootsio/data-cleaning-workshop
3. Send an email to our community mailing list: openrefine@googlegroups.com
